floor_history.headline: Recon: 3-insn gap fully characterised — 2 insns are the D_80101E70 reload gated on the pre-existing extern volatile the sandbox strips (17 vs 14 with --keep-cheat-asm); 1 insn is the a1->a3 parm copy

Structural axis measured dead: volatile carve-out census came back NEGATIVE (closed gate), 8-form ordering sweep found candidate.c is a strict local optimum in both regimes, and the missing a1->$a3 co
First permuter campaign ever run on this function broke the 3-session plateau: a pointer-mediated re-read of D_80101E70 produces the reload honestly, floor 17 -> 13 (36 -> 38 insns), and target's own

frontier.hypothesis: The remaining 13 points are pure register naming on top of an already instruction-exact body: a hybrid between v_d (13 / 38) and v_f (19 / 39) reaches 0.
frontier.mechanism: v_f proves target's statement order yields all 39 instructions with the parameter-home copy in the delay slot; v_d proves the pointer pair yields the lowest score at 38. The two forms differ by only three statement positions (where `D_80101E7C = a1;` sits, whether the two loads are adjacent, and where `D_80101E68 = 0;` sits). Each intermediate changes the live ranges global.c sees and therefore which hard regs the a1-home pseudo and the pe62 address pseudo receive.
frontier.next_probe: Move ONE statement at a time from v_d's order toward v_f's, sandboxing each of the ~6 intermediate forms, and disassemble any form that keeps 39 instructions. Reproduce the objdump diff with tmp/grind/replay_camera_Init/s3/setup_ws3.sh (apply form to src/, run sandbox, re-preprocess the sandbox copy, compile, objdump-diff against ws3/target.txt).

frontier.hypothesis: A permuter campaign seeded from the 39-instruction v_f - rather than from a 38-instruction form - closes the register-allocation residue.
frontier.mechanism: All three s3 campaigns were seeded from bodies that were one instruction short, so every mutation started from a structurally incomplete body and the search spent itself re-finding the missing insn. Seeding from v_f makes the search purely over register allocation and store order, which is exactly what remains.
frontier.next_probe: Apply v_f to src/, run `sandbox --disable all` to refresh the stripped copy, rebuild a ws4 with setup_ws3.sh's recipe, launch via tools/permuter_campaign.py with --stop-on-zero, wait IN-TURN with `wait --dir`, and sandbox-measure every de-permuted find (the permuter score is not a reliable proxy here).

frontier.hypothesis: The two /* FAKE */ pointer aliases in candidate.c survive a fresh layer-2 cheat-reviewer.
frontier.mechanism: pointer-alias-fake-exception is a sanctioned last-resort family (owner ruling 2026-07-01, SOTN precedent `tilemap = &g_Tilemap;`) whose prerequisites are documented lever-exhaustion, a named GCC-pass mechanism, and a /* FAKE */ annotation. s0's proposal was FAILed for supplying none of the three; candidate.c now supplies all three, and the exhaustion record is materially stronger after s1 H1-H4 and s2 H5-H7.
frontier.next_probe: Run a fresh cheat-reviewer on memory/grind/replay_camera_Init/candidate.c EARLY in s4, before spending the session on the register-naming residue - a FAIL reverts the floor to 17 and changes the whole frontier.
